dek: IDF launched a 'targeted & limited counterterrorism operation' in Hebron late Friday, expected to last several days: precise searches, suspect questioning, weapons seizures, three designated exit points. sources: IDF statement (X); Haaretz; Republic World; Times Now; Al Jazeera liveblog (Barghouti interview)
fault_line: Targeted counterterrorism or collective punishment days before the Oct 27 election?

sections.what_happened: IDF launched a 'targeted & limited counterterrorism operation' in Hebron late Friday, expected to last several days: precise searches, suspect questioning, weapons seizures, three designated exit points. Gunmen: Firas and Hamouda al-Jaaba (M16/M4 + handgun), both shot dead after 20-minute firefight. IDF names its dead: Staff Sgt. Ron Yonatan Roytman, Sgt. Yuval Shai Svilem; 3 others wounded. Netanyahu ordered full closure then scaled back to a cordon around Hebron and Halhul, possibly extending. Demolitions in Farsh al-Hawa (families given five minutes). Barghouti warns of collective punishment.
sections.what_verified: IDF (primary, via X statement); Haaretz (T3, declared) with Reuters photos; Republic World (T4); Times Now (T4) on scale-back; AJE liveblog (T2, state-flagged) for Barghouti. AP-reported checkpoint facts corroborate.
sections.what_disputed: IDF says 'targeted & limited'; Barghouti and rights framing say collective punishment/displacement. Netanyahu publicly ordered full closure, then scaled back — the order itself is contested policy.
sections.why_matters: Days before Israel votes, Hebron is under a multi-day operation and the West Bank's gates are closing — the security-vs-punishment fight is the election's shadow front.
